Al-Madinah in the Prophetic community context may cluster around formation, discipline, communal responsibility and implementation

quran.analyticalFinding: The scripture-only direct-place sample supports a Makkah-family profile centered on sanctuary/guidance/warning/orientation, while Prophetic-context al-Madinah is more strongly associated with communal testing, discipline, responsibility and social implementation. 'Education' is better treated as a broader formation hypothesis, not an explicit direct-place label.
